scripts.clean:macos-junk: find dist ios/App public src docs build app-store-screenshots test-artifacts -name '._*' -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 COPY_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES_DISABLE=1 vite build && npm run clean:macos-junk
scripts.ios:sync: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 COPY_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES_DISABLE=1 npm run build && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 COPY_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES_DISABLE=1 cap sync ios && npm run clean:macos-junk
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run i18n:check && npm run voice:check && npm run build
